query:
-- Ver estrutura de scheduledClasses
SELECT sc.id, sc.userId, sc.subjectId, sc.classId, s.name as subjectName, s.code as subjectCode, c.name as className, c.code as classCode
FROM scheduledClasses sc
LEFT JOIN subjects s ON s.id = sc.subjectId
LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.id = sc.classId
LIMIT 20;
